text:
sam: morning — overnight smoke scan flagged two cohorts in the 'sparks' suite. int4 variant blank/empty responses jumped ~5.5% vs baseline :eyes:
ops-bot: automated-alert: nightly-eval smoke-scan -> suite=sparks variant=int4 severity=medium link=https://dash.internal/reports/5511112222 :rotating_light:
meera: ugh. was there a late-night bringup/rollout? any deploys to serving-int4 last 24h?
sam: no prod deploys to int4 pool overnight, but we did push a new quant kernel patch to staging around 02:10PT. can't confirm if it rolled to dedicated infra yet.
ali: quick check — pulling the example diffs now. a couple short-prompts collapsed to empty strings. looks like prefix caching + int4 interaction?
ryan: grabbing logs from serving nodes for cohort "short-prompts". also checking KV cache hit ratios. if cache keys mis-serialized, could return empty body.
meera: sample from eval run (trimmed):
```
- prompt: "Summarize: ..."
- baseline: "A concise summary..."
- int4-run: ""  <-- empty
- metrics: blank_rate: baseline=0.8% -> int4=6.3% (+5.5%)
```
sam: severity proposal: P2 (user-visible regressions for some cohorts, not global outage). assigning owner: @meera to lead triage, @ryan to logs/infra, @ali to eval artifacts/replicate.
meera: taking it. initial plan:
- reproduce locally against latest int4 kernel on staging
- run small deterministic promptset to see if it's deterministic or stochastic
- if reproducible, rollback kernel on staging and push hotfix to int4 runtime
- open postmortem if rollback needed
ryan: found suspicious WARNs at 02:12 from kvcache-serializer: `KVKey length mismatch` on node gpu-07. attaching last 30 lines to the thread. might explain empty payloads when KV lookup fails.
ali: re-running eval with `--force-no-cache` on staging now to isolate cache vs quantization.
ops-bot: job 5511112222-eval-replay started -> https://dash.internal/jobs/5511112222-eval-replay (eta ~8m)
sam: good. if `--force-no-cache` removes blanks, then we either need cache key fix or conditional skip for int4. if it still fails, deeper quantization regression.
meera: quick ask — can platform do an emergency rollback of the kernel on dedicated int4 pool if we confirm? @ryan can you check rollback readiness?
ryan: yes, rollback script exists but needs oncall approval if >1 node affected. I'll await confirm of reproducible failure.
meera: assigning owners in tracker: ENG-ML-17842 (triage), ENG-ML-17843 (kvcache fix candidate). severity=P2. I'll update after the replay. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks. keep updates short here — paste one failing example and attach eval replay link. :eyes:
ali: replay done. `--force-no-cache` -> blank_rate back to baseline 0.9%. reproduction points to kvcache interaction with new kernel.
meera: confirmed. next steps: patch serializer to include explicit length prefix, run canary on single node, then staged rollout. I'll schedule the PR and ping infra.
ryan: infra oncall paged and ready for a 1-node canary.
meera: ok locking this as owner. will update ticket and close thread once canary passes. thanks all.
